name: Creative Composites Group, Augusta Molding Division
old_description: Creative Composites Group can help you advance your infrastructure projects beyond the limitations of traditional materials. We are the largest manufacturer of structural composites in the U.S. with innovative products across multiple industries.
about:
Creative Composites Group’s Augusta Molding Division operates from Augusta, Maine, as part of the Kenway Composites business unit. The division belongs to Creative Composites Group (CCG), a U.S.-based collection of composite manufacturers owned by Hill & Smith Holdings PLC, a UK-listed engineering group with divisions in engineered solutions, roads & security, and galvanizing services. CCG was formed to combine the expertise of several established composite companies, though a specific founding year for the Augusta operation is not publicly stated.

The division produces fiber-reinforced polymer (FRP) structural components and systems, offering design-build, structural fabrication, manufacturing, and engineering services. Its capabilities extend to industrial field services, specialized coatings, FRP repair and maintenance, tank and tower installation, lining, and pulp mill repair. The group emphasizes turnkey solutions from concept through installation, leveraging advanced composite manufacturing processes across its network of facilities.

Customers span telecommunications and data centers, energy generation and distribution, marine, rail, housing, pulp and paper, water and wastewater treatment, and chemical storage. The company cites telecom and data centers as a served industry, while its parent group’s portfolio includes infrastructure markets such as energy, marine, and rail.

CCG positions itself as the largest manufacturer of structural composites in the United States, differentiating through vertical integration of design, engineering, and manufacturing across multiple specialized brands. The organization highlights over 60 years of collective field service experience and an integrated model that combines the capabilities of its member companies to deliver corrosion-resistant, lightweight, and long-lasting composite solutions.
